title: Red-green color vision deficiency and blue/orange palettes
statement:
To support the 8% of men with red-green color vision deficiencies (Deuteranomaly/Protanomaly), maps and interfaces should use blue/orange diverging palettes rather than red/green.

Options:
- Colorblind Safe: Blue / Orange Palette (fits: charts, system status)
- Unsafe (Requires Icons): Red / Green Palette (fits: avoid unless supplemented)
- Monochromatic Safe: Lightness Stepping (fits: heatmaps, density plots)
appliesWhen: Applies to: data visualization, dashboards, status indicators. Audience: general.

source.title: Color Design for the Color Vision Impaired
